document: R6-HYGIENE-01. The one-way warning ratchet's baseline, enforced by tools/ci/warning_ratchet.py. Crates that CAN be held at `-D warnings` are not listed here - they are denied outright in the CI hygiene job (protocol-models, storage-diff-spike, remote-wal-spike). This file exists only for crates whose warnings we do not own yet; every entry is a debt with a stated composition, and the number may only ever go down.
